name: mobile_octopus

balance.about: weight-shift coordinate: the base moves so the CoM moves toward a direction inside this polygon; a tip may lift once the CoM is inside the polygon of the others (dilated 0.1 L)

gaits.name: omnidirectional_ripple_walk
gaits.about: A six-leg ripple walk lifts only one radial leg at a time. Each lifted leg resets to the leading end of its commanded stroke, then joins five grounded legs that sweep gradually through their stance. This preserves a broad support region while translating or turning.

gaits.name: alternating
gaits.source: synthesised from measured tips (angular order, alternate phases)

gaits.name: crawl
gaits.source: synthesised quasi-static crawl from measured tips (one limb lifted at a time)

frames: base frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres; for the arm a level frame at its base
